question: Which ordering policy is cheapest at Plant 2?
How accurate is the vehicle build forecast 13 weeks out?
How have real-world EV recalls changed by component since 2020?
Which single-sourced parts depend on a tier C supplier?
What should we expedite today?
Which parts are we holding that a pending engineering change will supersede?
Where does engineering change cycle time go?
Which suppliers are getting worse?
What is our on-time delivery by supplier region this year?

content: This space covers the supply chain of an EV maker: 3 vehicle models (PU pickup, SUV, VAN delivery van), two plants (PLT1 Midwest, PLT2 Southeast - PLT2 launched in March 2026 and is still ramping) and a service parts DC (SDC1).
Always use MEASURE() on the metric views for rates and averages (On-Time Rate, WAPE, Stockout Rate, Days of Cover). They are ratios of sums - never average a percentage column.
On time means received on or before the promised date. Automakers expect 95%+ on-time delivery.
Supplier tiers: A 97%+ on time, B 90-97%, C under 90%, Unrated = not enough history. In supplier_delivery_metrics, Supplier Tier is the tier at the time of delivery; Current Supplier Tier is today's.
A declining supplier is one getting at least 0.15 days later every month over the last 24 months (is_declining).
Most auto parts are single-sourced on purpose. High risk means single-sourced from a tier C supplier.

Buffer classes: JIT (local body and wiring, daily deliveries, half a day of buffer), KANBAN (local fasteners, min/max), STANDARD (95% service level), STRATEGIC (battery materials and electronics, 99% service level).
Buy signals: EXPEDITE = on hand below safety stock, ORDER = inventory position below the reorder point, EXCESS = over twice the max. DRR = daily run rate (forecast average daily usage).
The chip shortage ran June 2021 to December 2022, worst around April 2022. It shows up in Electronics by Order Month.

Ordering policies were simulated over the last 52 weeks with the same demand and late deliveries: Current, Lean, High service, EOQ, DDMRP, MRP (schedule). Lead with Stockout Rate (share of parts that ran out at least once) and Total Cost; unit fill rate always looks high because cheap high-volume parts dominate it.
Forecast accuracy compares LightGBM with a naive baseline. Lower WAPE is better. 'This year' means calendar 2026.

Product development: each vehicle program goes through prototype build phases EP (engineering prototype), VP (validation prototype) and PPV (pre-production), then SOP (start of production). Programs: Pickup launch, SUV launch, Delivery van launch, SUV plant 2 launch.

Issues are found in prototype builds and production, severity S1 (stop-ship) to S4 (cosmetic). Serious issues raise engineering changes (ECOs), which move Draft > In review > Approved > Implemented (or Rejected). Implemented changes update the BOM.
ECO, ECN, change order and engineering change all mean the same thing here. Cycle time = created to implemented.

mart_bom_current is today's multi-level BOM flattened: system > assembly > part with quantity per vehicle and cost. mart_eco_supply_exposure lists parts a pending change will replace or remove, with the stock and buy signal at risk.

ev_recall_metrics is REAL public data from NHTSA (every US recall campaign involving a battery-electric vehicle since 2012), unlike the rest of this space, which is a simulated company. Say which one an answer comes from. EV units affected only counts campaigns where every vehicle is an EV, because mixed campaigns report units for petrol vehicles too.

question: How did electronics lead times change during the chip shortage?
sql:
SELECT `Order Month`, MEASURE(`Avg Lead Time Days`) AS avg_lead_time_days, MEASURE(`On-Time Rate`) AS on_time_rate
FROM workspace.ev_gold.supplier_delivery_metrics WHERE `Component Category` = 'Electronics' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY `Order Month`

question: How have real-world EV recalls changed by component and year?
sql:
SELECT `Report Year`, `Component Category`, MEASURE(`Recall Campaigns`) AS campaigns, MEASURE(`OTA Share`) AS ota_share
FROM workspace.ev_gold.ev_recall_metrics WHERE `Report Year` >= 2020 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY `Report Year`, campaigns DESC

question: How do issues fall as a program matures?
sql:
SELECT `Program`, `Found Phase`, MEASURE(`Issues`) AS issues, MEASURE(`ECO Conversion Rate`) AS issue_to_change_rate
FROM workspace.ev_gold.prototype_issue_metrics GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY `Program`, `Found Phase`

question: Where does engineering change cycle time go, by phase raised?
sql:
SELECT `Raised In Phase`, MEASURE(`Changes`) AS changes, MEASURE(`Avg Days In Review`) AS review_days,
       MEASURE(`Avg Days To Approve`) AS approve_days, MEASURE(`Avg Days To Implement`) AS implement_days,
       MEASURE(`Avg Cycle Time Days`) AS cycle_time_days
FROM workspace.ev_gold.engineering_change_metrics GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY `Raised In Phase`

question: What should we expedite today?
sql:
SELECT site_id, part_number, part_name, supplier_name, days_of_cover, safety_stock_days, suggested_order_qty, suggested_order_value
FROM workspace.ev_gold.mart_buy_signals WHERE signal = 'EXPEDITE' ORDER BY suggested_order_value DESC LIMIT 50

question: How accurate is the forecast by horizon?
sql:
SELECT `Forecast Type`, `Model`, `Horizon Weeks`, MEASURE(`WAPE`) AS wape
FROM workspace.ev_gold.forecast_accuracy_metrics GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY `Forecast Type`, `Horizon Weeks`, `Model`

question: Which suppliers are getting worse?
sql:
SELECT supplier_name, country, tier, lateness_trend_days_per_month, on_time_rate_prior_12m, on_time_rate_last_12m, spend
FROM workspace.ev_gold.mart_supplier_scorecard WHERE is_declining ORDER BY lateness_trend_days_per_month DESC

question: How much spend is at risk by category?
sql:
SELECT `Component Category`, MEASURE(`High-Risk Parts`) AS high_risk_parts, MEASURE(`Spend at Risk`) AS spend_at_risk
FROM workspace.ev_gold.sourcing_risk_metrics GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY spend_at_risk DESC

question: What is on-time delivery by supplier region?
sql:
SELECT `Supplier Region`, MEASURE(`On-Time Rate`) AS on_time_rate, MEASURE(`Delivery Lines`) AS deliveries
FROM workspace.ev_gold.supplier_delivery_metrics GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY on_time_rate

question: Which ordering policy is cheapest at each site?
sql:
SELECT `Site`, `Policy`, MEASURE(`Total Cost`) AS total_cost, MEASURE(`Stockout Rate`) AS stockout_rate,
       MEASURE(`Avg Inventory Value`) AS avg_inventory_value
FROM workspace.ev_gold.policy_simulation_metrics GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY `Site`, total_cost

question: Which parts are we holding that a pending engineering change will supersede?
sql:
SELECT site_id, part_number, part_name, eco_id, eco_status, change_type, signal, stock_at_risk_value, recommended_action
FROM workspace.ev_gold.mart_eco_supply_exposure ORDER BY stock_at_risk_value DESC LIMIT 25

question: What is on-time delivery by supplier region?

content:
SELECT `Supplier Region`, MEASURE(`On-Time Rate`) AS on_time_rate, MEASURE(`Delivery Lines`) AS deliveries
FROM workspace.ev_gold.supplier_delivery_metrics GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY on_time_rate

question: How much spend is at risk by category?

content:
